name: Mrs. Knott's Fresh Fluffy Buttermilk Biscuits with Boysenberry Jam
whyItWorks: Freshly baked buttermilk biscuits are light, tender, and soft on the digestive system. Topped with a moderate smear of Knott's famous boysenberry jam, it provides comforting carbohydrates.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the soft interior of the biscuit with seedless boysenberry jam or butter. Chew thoroughly.
